history.overview: The Dranik Sewers were once a vital Dragorn infrastructure, later seized and corrupted by Muramite invaders.

timeline.name: Dragorn Construction
timeline.description: The sewers were engineered to channel water and trade beneath Dranik’s cities.

timeline.name: Muramite Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the tunnels, converting them into hidden war camps.

timeline.name: Discord Infestation
timeline.description: Discord energy seeped into the waterways, warping stone and spawning horrors.

timeline.name: Resistance Infiltration
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels attempted infiltration but suffered heavy losses.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The sewers remain a corrupted undercity filled with Muramite forces and Discord anomalies.
